# Core Web Vitals (Addy Osmani)

Diagnoses and fixes LCP, INP and CLS problems using field and lab data.

- Source: https://github.com/addyosmani/web-quality-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/addyosmani/web-quality-skills/main/skills/core-web-vitals/SKILL.md
- Author: Addy Osmani
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/core-web-vitals-addy-osmani-af95e4c1

Claude starts by measuring, using field data to see user impact and browser traces to find causes, then works through each metric: common Largest Contentful Paint issues and a checklist, Interaction to Next Paint, and Cumulative Layout Shift. It includes quick fixes for Next.js, React and Vue or Nuxt, and reference material.

**Try asking:**
- "Our LCP is 4.2s on mobile. Find out why and fix it"
- "Reduce layout shift on the product page"
- "Improve INP on this React dashboard"
